name: Nuage DB
description: Nuage DB, Memoire's own database in Rust: tables on disk behind a write-ahead log, instant branches, backups restored at boot, an HTTP API, a management console at /admin and a live dashboard at /app.

NUAGE_TOKEN.description: Token of the database API (clients send it as a bearer token).

NUAGE_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Password of the console at /admin (it also opens the live dashboard at /app).

NUAGE_PUBLIC_STATUS.description: true: /api/status and /app show a public subset (status, uptime, services) without signing in.

NUAGE_BACKUP_S3_BUCKET.description: Bucket for the backups. The dyno's disk is erased at each restart: the data is restored from here at boot.

NUAGE_BACKUP_S3_ENDPOINT.description: Endpoint URL of S3-compatible storage (leave empty for AWS).

SITE_URL.description: Public address of the website (canonical links, share card), e.g. https://my-nuage.herokuapp.com. Empty: taken from each request.
